title: Romantic ga Hoshii nara feat. Nao Kosaka, Youko Shougenji, Kaho Fujishima (Hinatazaka46)

alternative_titles.ja: ロマンティックがほしいなら feat. 小坂菜緒, 正源司陽子, 藤嶌果歩 (日向坂46)

synopsis: Music video for the song Romantic ga Hoshii nara by Botchi Boromaru featuring Nao Kosaka, Youko Shougenji and Kaho Fujishima (Hinatazaka46). The song was used as the ending theme of the anime Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi 2nd Season.
